text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, Red Desire asked me
to watch her dance practice, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...O rampaging evil dragon...
Sink into eternal slumber."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—How was it?
You've seen a bit of everything now—the festival,
the requiem, and the rituals to appease the dragon.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪
Dancing is one of the essential duties of a saintess, so I must devote myself to practice before visiting the other Sekai—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: U... Uwoooooh! That's awesooome!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, V-Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what was with that dance just now?
That wasn't just basic choreography to match the music, was it!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... That was, well, a dance with a bit of a ritualistic meaning, you could say.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It's an arrangement I made myself
in order to fulfill my duties as a Saint."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Maybe that's why? Watching it
somehow made my chest burn with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Desire, I've got a favor to ask.
Could you teach me that dance from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna try doing a dance like that one earlier,
the kind that fires people up from the bottom of their hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san...!
...I understand.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Then I must tell you beforehand.
About the 'essence' of the Saint's Dance.
And that is—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...And what might that be?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To "believe until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, a dragon lands before our eyes,
about to reduce the village to ashes with hellfire—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Before a calamity, one naturally trembles and wants to flee.
Yet, only my dance can quell it.
If so, I shall soothe it—even at the cost of my life.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes—you must "believe to the end."
Truly fearing, steeling your resolve, and feeling a sense of duty beyond that—that is the essence of the Saint's Dance.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I think I understand now.
Why my soul was trembling so much back then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Going all-out in everything is what counts... right!
Alright, I'm ready for this.
Let's do this, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a truly dazzling, earnest person.
Of course, I will teach you with all my heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
Since you are here, won't you choose for us?
What sort of dance we ought to perform.
choice_data_list: How about a saintess and the hero who protects her?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That really gets me the most fired up!
Bring on whoever ya got!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is someone still practicing
at this hour............ huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe, looks like that lizard bastard
is about ready for bed, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your guard down. Our opponent is the strongest living being;
we must pour our feelings and souls together and dance all the way through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
J-Just what are they fighting against...
That giant... black thing—!
I-Is this an illusion...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing in each other without a shred of doubt,
their dance was so breathtaking it created an illusion
for all who watched.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, that is wonderful!
After all, a hero is essential to the legend of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, it got super late.
Huh, is someone still doing a lesson............ wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's an evil dragon or a legion of demons, I'll cut them all down. So—
don't you dare leave my side.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: How reassuring. However, protecting everything is the duty of a saint. Please, entrust the people's peace—and your back—to me!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-What precious radiance...!
It's so bright, my eyes, my eyyyes~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her earnest dance radiated a dazzling brilliance,
so magnificent that it felt as though it would
be passed down as a legend.
